items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Spokane is where Bing Crosby was born, right?

ctx.x: Well, this is September 27, 1984, I'm Dan Morgenstern, and we are talking to Jimmy Rowles. [ETC.]
So we said the story goes from there. Spokane is where Bing Crosby was born, right?
